note: Descriptive arithmetic on the rows the engine kept, in the engine's own comparison windows (the latest 12 months against the 12 before); the monthly totals of these rows match the engine's own charted series. The headline figures carry the claim's grade; a figure derived from them is not graded itself and names the grade of the change it is part of. A contribution says where the change sits, not what caused it, and a what-if is arithmetic, not a forecast. The figures are shown rounded; they add up before rounding.
